narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies has $323M in contract obligations for FY2027 to date. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies recorded 1 award this fiscal year, making the average award size $323M, and obligations fell 85.8% year over year. Historical fiscal-year obligations remained well above the current-year total: FY22 obligations were $2B, FY23 obligations were $1.8B, FY24 obligations were $1.8B, FY25 obligations were $2.1B, and FY26 obligations were $2.3B. The current-year total is partial and reflects fiscal year to date activity. The concentration of FY2027 obligations into a single award stands in contrast to the multi-year funding pattern. The figures provided do not identify agency buyers, product lines, or expiring contracts, so further contract-level analysis will require additional source data.
